top_signals.title: To Implement Acquisition Transformation, Empower Military Mavericks
top_signals.summary:
“I wanted disciplined but not regimented thinking. Commanders must encourage intellectual risk-taking to preclude a lethargic environment. Leaders must shelter those challenging nonconformists and mavericks who make institutions uncomfortable; otherwise you wash out innovation.”— James Mattis & Bing West, Call Sign ChaosFor the last decade, the Pentagon has had the authorities to buy commercially derived technologies at speed and scale, but not enough people who know how to use those authorities. top_signals.title: Peru’s Economy Unexpectedly Slows as Mining, Farming Slump
top_signals.summary: Peru’s economy unexpectedly slowed in September, dragged down by weak mining and agriculture output.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: FBI flash alert says Artex tool automating cyberattacks at ‘machine speed’
top_signals.summary: Open source hacking tool Artex "significantly reduces the time required to chain attack techniques, with some intrusions progressing from initial targeting to privileged access in under three hours," the FBI said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
